name: GUBBY RNG [🛠️]
desc:
👑 PREMIUM PLAYERS GET X1.3 LUCK & X1.3 $GUBS MULTIPLIER! 👑

👍 PUT A LIKE AND ADD THE GAME TO YOUR FAVORITES TO GET MORE UPDATES AND FREE REWARDS! 👍

👋  Welcome to a Gubby hangout place, named GUBBY RNG!

🐇🎲 In Gubby RNG, you play as a Gubby, a little bunny. 
You should combine cubes with the same numbers and drop them to the hole (near the spawn) to earn $GUBS, which you can use to buy new accessories for your little Gubby!

🍀🌀 Spin to get cool and rare accessories for your Gubby to show your luck and show off!
You can also trade your accessories with other players!

💸🤑  Will you get the first place and be the richest player in the game?

❗️ You can also join to our group https://roblox.com/communities/35691496/skve1tyy ❗️
